title: 嵌套运行用量去重与聚合
acceptance_tests: out-of-order nested runs, multi-root totals, duplicates, and cached subset
deduplication uses a tuple, ignores extras, and normalizes absent counters
duplicate conflicts and inconsistent run parents are rejected
missing parents, self references, and disconnected cycles are rejected
validation rejects malformed ledgers and unsafe or inconsistent counters
aggregated overflow is rejected within a run, subtree, or separate roots
deep frozen input is accepted and deeply nested runs do not overflow the call stack
